messages:
Alex K: Heads-up — saw a few 503s on production while primary-xxl was saturated. Thinking we need a formal 'spillover' policy to route to smaller variants automatically instead of rejecting. Anyone have strong opinions on priorities (latency vs. cost vs. quality)?
Maria P: +1 we should avoid hard 503s. auto-variant routing sounds right; we need guardrails. cost/quality tradeoff depends on customer tier. maybe prefer same-architecture quantized variants first.
Chris L: Agreed. Proposal: try these in order -> warm quantized variant (same family), then smaller model family, then cross-region fallback. Each step should be instrumented with reason codes.
Alex K: nice. Also want telemetry: per-tenant spill_count, avg-latency-change, and a badge in Console per-route with spill rate and SLA impact.
Olivia (deploy-bot): deploy triggered: route-testing/variant-spillover v1 -> staging at 1965439930 :spinner:
Tina S: UX note — console rollout page should surface 'auto-spill' toggle with editable preference (prefer_speed|prefer_quality|prefer_cost). Default depends on customer tier.
Maria P: Implementation detail — runtime needs a fast capacity check. We can expose a `serve_hint` from scheduler: {capacity_score, warm_variants}. Pseudocode:
```
if capacity_score < threshold:
  for v in warm_variants:
    try route(v)
```
Need idempotent circuit for retries.
Chris L: Also need a backoff/decay window per-tenant so we don't oscillate. e.g., once spilled, mark tenant suppressed for 30s unless metrics improve.
Alex K: What about billing? Should we prefer cheaper variant but bill at primary's rate? Customers will be upset. Maybe show per-request effective_model and meter accordingly.
Maria P: I'm leaning to billing at actual model used with a visible note in console. For enterprise we can add opt-in for preserving billed model.
Tina S: Ops ask — telemetry must include request sample (anonymized) and delta in token count/latency to detect quality regressions. Should tie into alerts/quality-eval hooks.
Chris L: Security: private deployments can't spill to hosted variants. Need explicit deny in VPC config.
Alex K: Action items: Maria to draft console UX, Chris to design scheduler API, Tina to enumerate telemetry events, I'll add a short RFC. Let's aim for alpha in 2 weeks.
Maria P: I'll post a quick mock in #design by EOD. @Chris L can you estimate effort?
Chris L: rough estimate: 6 engineer-days across runtime + 3 for Console + 2 for telemetry. Happy to pair.
Olivia (deploy-bot): reminder: weekly-svc-check scheduled for 1965440500 — results will help validate.
Alex K: thanks team :thumbsup:
